descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses — from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs — to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re hiring a Research Analyst to identify and communicate the trends that will drive the next wave of stablecoin adoption. The title is negotiable, ranging from analyst to lead analyst. What matters is the experience you bring and the insight you can deliver. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of blockchain, data science, and measuring the economy of the future. As a Research Analyst, you’ll combine industry knowledge with unparalleled access to data to understand what drives adoption of stablecoins today and in the future. You will develop new ways to understand the ecosystem and validate them with data. You’ll share insights, via reports, presentations, and data visualizations, with internal teams and for external communication. For the deepest insights, you’ll help put them in production for continuous monitoring and dashboarding. You will work within the Economics team, where our mission is to quantify and communicate the impact of Tether’s technologies, primarily our stablecoin, USDt. We are a lean, fully remote, team that leverages thoughtful decision-making, experiments, technology, and vendor partnerships to scale. Our work is impactful, opinionated, and precise. We thrive on collaboration, autonomy, and delivering meaningful outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. You’ll work on new and complex data analysis with agility, curiosity to learn about the domain, and a willingness to stretch yourself. Responsibilities You’ll be responsible for researching the stablecoin industry, covering:
• Use cases and users: current and emerging use cases for stablecoins, and the user journey and adoption of these use cases.
• Market structure: current and emerging venues for stablecoin usage, and their competitive dynamics.
• Opportunities: future channels for stablecoin adoption and their timing and venues. You’ll be successful if you focus on:
• Curiosity: You develop and test hypotheses that lead to novel insights, which change how the business thinks and acts.
• Communication: Stakeholders easily understand your findings and act on them; your external research is cited and shared across the industry.
• Growth: Your approach to research reflects the scale and speed of the business: you build context, prioritise ruthlessly, and automate wherever possible. You’re an experienced and self-motivated researcher who is opinionated yet collaborative. You’re an expert in your domain yet willing to work on new problems and support the team. Autonomy and remote work brings out the best in you. You have the courage to be wrong in your analysis and the pride to learn why because, above all else, you care about the impact your work has. You typically work in or to the west of the Central European timezone, which may include American timezones. Required skills and experience:
• Deep knowledge of the stablecoin and digital asset industry.
• Deep expertise in quantitative analysis using languages such as SQL, R, or Python, and expertise in version control (e.g. GitHub).
• Proven ability to present findings to senior internal stakeholders and author external-facing research.
• Proven ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment. Preferred skills and experience:
• An existing network within the stablecoin and digital asset industry.
• Experience working with blockchain data.
• Hands-on experience with data warehouses (e.g. Databricks) and dbt.
• Experience with JavaScript for dashboard development. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities. The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience. Responsibilities
• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.
• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.
• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.
• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.
• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.
• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.
• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.
• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.
• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.
• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.
• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.
• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

About the job Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain. Responsibilities
• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.
• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.
• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.
• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.
• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.
• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.
• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.
• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.
• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk. Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.
• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.
• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).
• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).
• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.
• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.
• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement. Preferred / Advantageous
• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).
• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.
• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices. Native module development
• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests
• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript
• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list Cross-platform builds and CI
• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)
• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform
• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms
• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues Bare Runtime contributions
• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)
• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface
• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry Debugging and quality
• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile
• Write and maintain tests for all modules Collaboration and communication
• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.
• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .
• Participate in a weekly status call.
• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.
• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).
• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.
• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.
• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.
• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.
• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).
• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.
• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

About the job Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations. Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.
• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.
• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.
• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.
• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.
• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.
• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements. Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.
• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.
• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.
• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.
• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.
• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.
• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.
• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.
• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments. Preferred / Advantageous
• Prior experience operating in Central America.
• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.
• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

About the job The Engagement Manager will lead the implementation journey of tokenization projects based on Hadron for institutional clients, acting as the primary technical and business point of contact throughout onboarding and early operations. This role is pivotal in ensuring a seamless transition from contract signature through the first production token issuance and continuous monitoring of the initiative, maintaining alignment across stakeholders, and coordinating execution across internal teams, client counterparts, and external partners. As Engagement Manager, you can expect to work with global institutional clients across multiple geographies and asset classes on complex tokenization initiatives involving digital asset issuance, custody frameworks, and integration into existing financial infrastructures within a regulated and rapidly evolving environment. This role offers the opportunity to actively shape how institutions adopt tokenized assets, operating in a fully remote setup with flexible global collaboration. As the scope and volume of implementations grow, there is a clear path to evolve into broader technical strategy or client success leadership roles. Responsibilities Before the engagement (pre-sales)
• Assist Expansion Managers in preparing and conducting demos
• As consultant, propose solutions during pre-sales phase of the engagement
• Assist in defining the engagement scope, ensuring it’s correctly reflected in the Client agreement Onboarding & Integration
• Lead project kickoffs and define the integration roadmap with clients
• Guide clients through API documentation, sandbox testing, and UAT
• Diagnose and troubleshoot client integration issues
• Coordinate between clients, engineering teams, and external infrastructure partners during integrations
• Track onboarding progress, milestones, and dependencies to ensure clients reach production within expected timelines
• Prepare clients for production launch and conduct monitoring and hyper-care after launch
• Maintain an enterprise-grade, consulting-like knowledge base around implementation use cases
• Create integration documentation and operational runbooks and adapt them as needed to tailor each client implementation Client Communication & Problem-Solving
• Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the execution of the engagement
• Translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders
• Identify integration pain points and escalate product feedback
• Proactively communicate timelines, blockers, and dependencies
• Support transition clients to self-service with comprehensive documentation
• Proactively identify up- and cross-sell opportunities, to be passed on to Expansion Managers What You Won’t Do
• Write or audit smart contracts (clients own their tokenomics)
• Perform regulatory or legal structuring
• Build custom features or bespoke integrations Core skills
• 3–6 years of experience in technical account management , solutions engineering, technical consulting, project management of technical implementations or integrations, or client success management
• Strong understanding of APIs and system integrations
• Comfort diagnosing and resolving integration issues
• Excellent communication skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders
• Experience coordinating across multiple teams and external partners
• Ability to track and manage technical project timelines
• English proficiency is mandatory Nice to Have
• Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure or digital assets
• Experience with fintech or institutional financial infrastructure
• Familiarity with token standards (ERC-20, ERC-1400) or Ethereum basics
• Background in fin-tech, supporting financial institutions or complex B2B integrations
• Basic programming knowledge ( Python, JavaScript ) or API tools Who You Are
• Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, global environment
• Self-directed and able to own integration workflows end-to-end
• Detail-oriented, documenting decisions and learnings as you go
• Collaborative, able to work effectively with engineering teams and demanding clients

About the job As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, the Solutions Partner Manager is responsible for managing, enabling, and governing a network of consulting firms, system integrators, and delivery partners who implement Tether products (WDK, QVAC, and MOS). The role ensures partners deliver high-quality projects, align with Tether’s interests, meet certification standards, and drive customer satisfaction. Responsibilities 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management
• Act as the primary relationship owner for all Solutions Partners.
• Coordinate the assessment of partner capabilities, delivery maturity, and resources.
• Ensure partners maintain sufficient certified consultants and technical capacity.
• Conduct regular capability reviews and develop partner improvement plans as needed. 2. Partner Onboarding & Certification
• Lead the onboarding of new implementation partners, including due diligence and contract execution.
• Coordinate partner training and certification programs
• Ensure adherence to implementation playbooks, best practices, and delivery frameworks. 3. Delivery Governance
• Oversee partner-led implementations to ensure alignment with methodology, quality standards, and timelines.
• Participate in project kick-offs, milestone reviews, and governance checkpoints.
• Validate partner deliverables (e.g., configurations, integration setups, testing documentation).
• Manage escalations and coordinate resolutions with internal Technical, Support, and Product teams. 4. Project Portfolio Monitoring
• Maintain visibility over the entire portfolio of partner-led projects.
• Identify and flag cross-sell opportunities with other Tether products or with services offered by Tether portfolio companies, where relevant.
• Track delivery risks, resourcing gaps, and escalations across the partner ecosystem.
• Ensure Partners receive Technical support as required during their implementations 5. Quality Assurance & Performance Management
• Monitor KPIs such as project success rate, CSAT, and partner delivery quality.
• Perform quarterly partner performance reviews.
• Define corrective action plans or temporary delivery restrictions when required.
• Manage re-certification cycles and partner tiering. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination
• Work closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Support, Product, and Training teams.
• Ensure smooth transitions between sales-to-delivery and delivery-to-support phases.
• Provide feedback from partner projects to internal teams to improve product quality and implementation processes. 8. Partner Lifecycle Management
• Manage partner renewal, re-certification, and (if necessary) offboarding.
• Maintain partner records, capability matrices, and project performance logs.
• 4–8 years in Partner Management, Delivery Management, Professional Services, or Project Governance roles.
• Experience working with implementation partners, system integrators, or consulting firms.
• Strong understanding of software/IT implementation processes (integration, configuration, change management, UAT, go-live).
• Collaborate with world-class technical and business teams across multiple regions.
• Experience in SaaS, fintech, AI, blockchain, digital content platforms, or enterprise open source software.
• Previous work with partner-led delivery models or certification programs.
• Knowledge of partner governance tools, PMO frameworks, and QA processes.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e Plasma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale In Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, stiamo guidando una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende—dagli exchange e portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli ATM—di integrare senza problemi token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti permette di conservare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto a una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è il fondamento di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi include la stablecoin più affidabile al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi pionieristici di tokenizzazione di asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Promuovendo una crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'energia in eccesso per il mining di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecologiche in strutture all'avanguardia e geograficamente diversificate. Tether Data: Alimentando innovazioni nell'IA e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi infrastrutturali e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione sicura e privata dei dati. Tether Education: Democratizzando l'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, offriamo alle persone gli strumenti per prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig, promuovendo crescita e opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: All'intersezione tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è un concentrato di talenti globali, che lavora da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare il segno nel settore fintech, questa è la tua opportunità per collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, superare i limiti e stabilire nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti rapidamente, siamo rimasti snelli e ci siamo assicurati il nostro posto come leader del settore. Se hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Informazioni sul lavoro Il ruolo prevede di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico con un team diversificato di sviluppatori backend senior, product manager e leadership per costruire soluzioni di portafogli crypto. Le applicazioni devono essere ad alte prestazioni, leggere e altamente intuitive per soddisfare una varietà di pubblici. Lavorerai allo sviluppo di applicazioni mobili all'avanguardia che integrano portafogli crypto e funzionalità defi. Contribuirai anche ai componenti backend quando necessario per supportare le funzionalità mobili e sbloccare la consegna mobile. Fornirai inoltre leadership tecnica, guiderai le migliori pratiche di ingegneria mobile e supporterai altri ingegneri attraverso revisioni e mentoring. ## Responsabilità Leadership: Guidare un piccolo gruppo di ingegneri React Native. Prendere decisioni architettoniche, applicare standard di codifica e garantire una consegna tempestiva e di alta qualità. Sviluppo: Progettare e costruire applicazioni avanzate cross-platform per le piattaforme iOS e Android utilizzando React Native, revisionare il lavoro di altri ingegneri per garantire qualità e allineamento architettonico, e contribuire ai servizi backend o API quando richiesto per supportare la funzionalità mobile. Integrazione: Collaborare strettamente con gli sviluppatori backend, integrare SDK Javascript, librerie e servizi backend nelle applicazioni mobili, ed estendere la logica backend quando necessario per completare le funzionalità end-to-end. Collaborazione: Collaborare con product manager, designer e altri sviluppatori per fornire soluzioni innovative. Architettura: Possedere e definire modelli per la gestione dello stato, navigazione, prestazioni, modularizzazione e sicurezza nelle applicazioni mobili. ## Obbligatorio Esperienza approfondita con React, React-Native (principalmente con Expo), Redux e i principi fondamentali che li circondano. Altamente competente in JavaScript e ES6+. Esperienza con pipeline CI/CD per lo sviluppo mobile. Familiarità con pipeline e strumenti moderni per il front-end. Esperienza con moduli nativi (C++), WebSockets, API basate su RESTful. Esperienza in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) o Kotlin/Java (Android) per implementazioni a basso livello. Esperienza comprovata nella guida o mentoring di ingegneri mobili. Capacità dimostrata di possedere l'architettura per applicazioni React Native su larga scala. Forti capacità decisionali nella valutazione di framework, strumenti e modelli di sviluppo mobile. Esperienza nello sviluppo backend utilizzando Node o ambienti simili, con la capacità di implementare o regolare API e servizi che alimentano le funzionalità mobili. Comodità nel lavorare su tutto lo stack quando richiesto, mantenendo comunque una forte profondità nello sviluppo mobile. ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tieni presente quanto segue quando candidati per ruoli: Candidati solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaramente indicato. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati sulla nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verifica l'identità del recruiter. Tutti i nostri recruiter hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se hai dubbi, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web. Sii cauto con metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni avvengono tramite email e piattaforme ufficiali dell'azienda. Controlla due volte gli indirizzi email. Tutte le comunicazioni da parte nostra provengono da email che terminano con @tether.to o @tether.io Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno ti chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o pagamenti in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di una truffa. Segnalalo immediatamente. In caso di dubbi, non esitare a contattarci tramite il nostro sito web ufficiale.

Beschreibung Werden Sie Teil von Tether und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen Bei Tether entwickeln wir nicht nur Produkte, sondern treiben eine globale Finanzrevolution voran. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen—von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten—Reserve-gestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether Ihnen, digitale Token sofort, sicher und weltweit zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen, und das zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet Vertrauen in jede Transaktion. Innovieren mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktpalette umfasst die weltweit vertrauenswürdigste Stablecoin, USDT, die von Hunderten von Millionen weltweit genutzt wird, sowie bahnbrechende Dienstleistungen zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Nachhaltiges Wachstum fördern, unsere Energielösungen optimieren überschüssige Energie für das Bitcoin-Mining unter Verwendung umweltfreundlicher Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch diversifizierten Einrichtungen. Tether Data: Durchbrüche in KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie fördern, wir senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern globale Kommunikation mit hochmodernen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die sichere und private Datenfreigabe neu definiert. Tether Education: Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen, wir befähigen Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Ökonomien erfolgreich zu sein, und fördern globales Wachstum und Chancen. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum bei uns arbeiten? Unser Team ist ein globales Talentkraftwerk, das remote aus allen Ecken der Welt arbeitet. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, im Fintech-Bereich Spuren zu hinterlassen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns als Branchenführer etabliert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über die Stelle Die Rolle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung mit einem vielfältigen Team von erfahrenen Backend-Entwicklern, Produktmanagern und Führungskräften, um Lösungen für Krypto-Wallets zu entwickeln. Die Anwendungen sollen leistungsstark, leicht und hochintuitiv sein, um eine Vielzahl von Zielgruppen anzusprechen. Sie werden an der Entwicklung hochmoderner mobiler Anwendungen arbeiten, die Krypto-Wallets und DeFi-Funktionen integrieren. Sie werden auch zu Backend-Komponenten beitragen, wenn nötig, um mobile Funktionen zu unterstützen und die mobile Bereitstellung zu ermöglichen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie technische Führung übernehmen, mobile Engineering-Best Practices leiten und andere Ingenieure durch Reviews und Mentoring unterstützen. ## Verantwortlichkeiten Führung: Führen Sie eine kleine Gruppe von React Native-Ingenieuren. Treffen Sie architektonische Entscheidungen, setzen Sie Codierungsstandards durch und stellen Sie eine rechtzeitige und qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung sicher. Entwicklung: Entwerfen und entwickeln Sie fortschrittliche plattformübergreifende Anwendungen für die iOS- und Android-Plattformen mit React Native, überprüfen Sie die Arbeit anderer Ingenieure, um Qualität und architektonische Ausrichtung sicherzustellen, und tragen Sie bei Bedarf zu Backend-Diensten oder APIs bei, um die mobile Funktionalität zu unterstützen. Integration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Backend-Entwicklern zusammen, integrieren Sie Javascript-SDKs, Bibliotheken und Backend-Dienste in mobile Anwendungen und erweitern Sie die Backend-Logik, wenn nötig, um End-to-End-Funktionen abzuschließen. Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie mit Produktmanagern, Designern und anderen Entwicklern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern. Architektur: Besitzen und definieren Sie Muster für Zustandsverwaltung, Navigation, Leistung, Modularisierung und Sicherheit in mobilen Anwendungen. ## Erforderlich Umfassende Erfahrung mit React, React-Native (hauptsächlich rund um Expo), Redux und den grundlegenden Prinzipien. Hochkompetent in JavaScript und ES6+. Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines für die mobile Entwicklung. Vertraut mit modernen Front-End-Pipelines und Tools. Erfahren mit nativen Modulen (C++), WebSockets, RESTful-basierten APIs. Erfahrung in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) oder Kotlin/Java (Android) für Implementierungen auf niedriger Ebene. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Mentoring von mobilen Ingenieuren. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Architektur für groß angelegte React Native-Anwendungen zu besitzen. Starke Entscheidungsfähigkeiten bei der Bewertung von Frameworks, Tools und mobilen Entwicklungsmodellen. Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Node oder ähnlichen Umgebungen, mit der Fähigkeit, APIs und Dienste zu implementieren oder anzupassen, die mobile Funktionen unterstützen. Komfortables Arbeiten über den gesamten Stack, wenn erforderlich, während dennoch eine starke Tiefe in der mobilen Entwicklung beibehalten wird. ## Wichtige Informationen für Bewerber Rekrutierungsbetrug wird immer häufiger. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes bei der Bewerbung für Stellen: Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen keine Drittanbieterplattformen oder Agenturen für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist ausdrücklich angegeben. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben verifizierte LinkedIn-
• Profile. Wenn Sie unsicher sind, können Sie deren Identität überprüfen, indem Sie deren Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren. Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Alle Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Unternehmens-E-Mails und Plattformen. Überprüfen Sie E-Mail-Adressen doppelt. Alle Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die mit @tether.to oder @tether.io enden. Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details anfordern. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen finanziellen Informationen oder Zahlungen fragt, handelt es sich um einen Betrug. Bitte melden Sie dies sofort. Im Zweifelsfall können Sie uns gerne über unsere offizielle Website kontaktieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous révolutionnons la finance mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises—des plateformes d'échange et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et distributeurs automatiques—d'intégrer facilement des tokens adossés à des réserves sur des blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, envoyer et recevoir des tokens numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est la pierre angulaire de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innover avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, USDT, utilisé par des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n'est que le début: Tether Power: Favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès d'énergie pour le minage de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géographiquement diversifiées et à la pointe de la technologie. Tether Data: Alimentant des avancées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage sécurisé et privé de données. Tether Education: Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous donnons aux individus les moyens de réussir dans les économies numériques et de travail indépendant, favorisant la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution: À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines se fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre? Notre équipe est un concentré de talents mondiaux, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par l'idée de laisser votre empreinte dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est votre opportunité de collaborer avec certaines des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et de définir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés agiles et avons sécurisé notre place en tant que leader de l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit qu'il vous faut. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie de l'avenir? À propos du poste Le rôle implique de travailler dans un environnement dynamique avec une équipe diversifiée de développeurs backend seniors, chefs de produit et dirigeants pour construire des solutions de portefeuilles crypto. Les applications doivent être performantes, légères et hautement intuitives pour répondre à une variété de publics. Vous travaillerez au développement d'applications mobiles de pointe intégrant des portefeuilles crypto et des fonctionnalités DeFi. Vous contribuerez également aux composants backend lorsque nécessaire pour soutenir les fonctionnalités mobiles et débloquer la livraison mobile. Vous fournirez également un leadership technique, guiderez les meilleures pratiques en ingénierie mobile et soutiendrez d'autres ingénieurs à travers des revues et du mentorat. ## Responsabilités Leadership: Diriger un petit groupe d'ingénieurs React Native. Prendre des décisions architecturales, appliquer des normes de codage et garantir une livraison rapide et de haute qualité. Développement: Concevoir et construire des applications avancées multiplateformes pour les plateformes iOS et Android en utilisant React Native, examiner le travail d'autres ingénieurs pour garantir la qualité et l'alignement architectural, et contribuer aux services backend ou API lorsque nécessaire pour soutenir la fonctionnalité mobile. Intégration: Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs backend, intégrer des SDK Javascript, des bibliothèques et des services backend dans les applications mobiles, et étendre la logique backend lorsque nécessaire pour compléter les fonctionnalités de bout en bout. Collaboration: Collaborer avec les chefs de produit, les designers et d'autres développeurs pour fournir des solutions innovantes. Architecture: Posséder et définir des modèles pour la gestion d'état, la navigation, les performances, la modularisation et la sécurité dans les applications mobiles. ## Obligatoire Expérience approfondie avec React, React-Native (principalement autour d'Expo), Redux et les principes fondamentaux qui les entourent. Très compétent en JavaScript et ES6+. Expérience avec les pipelines CI/CD pour le développement mobile. Familiarité avec les pipelines et outils modernes de front-end. Expérience avec les modules natifs (C++), WebSockets, APIs basées sur RESTful. Expérience en Swift/Objective-C (iOS) ou Kotlin/Java (Android) pour les implémentations de bas niveau. Expérience avérée dans la direction ou le mentorat d'ingénieurs mobiles. Capacité démontrée à posséder l'architecture pour des applications React Native à grande échelle. Solides compétences en prise de décision dans l'évaluation des frameworks, outils et modèles de développement mobile. Expérience en développement backend utilisant Node ou des environnements similaires, avec la capacité d'implémenter ou d'ajuster des APIs et services qui alimentent les fonctionnalités mobiles. À l'aise pour travailler sur toute la pile lorsque nécessaire, tout en maintenant une forte expertise en développement mobile. ## Informations importantes pour les candidats Les arnaques de recrutement sont de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit les points suivants lors de votre candidature: Postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou agences tierces pour le recrutement sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont listés sur notre page officielle des carrières: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. Si vous avez des doutes, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens via WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via des emails et des plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses email. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'emails se terminant par @tether.to ou @tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un vous demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus de recrutement, il s'agit d'une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site web officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The Senior Technical Product Manager will be responsible for the overall product leadership of Hadron, including product vision, roadmap definition, and delivery execution. The role serves as the single point of accountability for the platform to serve institutional client needs, engineering delivery, and regulatory/compliance requirements. Unlike a traditional Product Manager role, this position requires clear decision-making authority to:
• Set and enforce roadmap priorities, including pushing back on non-essential requests.
• Coordinate with external engineering partners and maintain scope discipline.
• Resolve conflicts between client requests, technical feasibility, and compliance constraints.
• Make go/no-go decisions on integrations, product features, and releases.
• Ensure product development aligns with the long-term architecture and scalability of the Hadron platform. Critical Context Hadron serves institutional clients globally with diverse and often conflicting tokenization requirements, including different asset classes, blockchain networks, compliance frameworks, and distribution models. The Product Manager must manage this complexity by maintaining a clear product strategy, prioritizing ruthlessly, and preventing scope creep. The role requires strong ownership and the ability to make difficult prioritization decisions in a fast-moving institutional environment. Reporting & Collaboration Reports to: VP Product The Product Manager works in close partnership with the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron to ensure strong alignment between institutional client demand, market opportunities, and the Hadron product roadmap. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor provides continuous market feedback based on institutional client engagements and strategic partnerships, ensuring that product development reflects real market demand. The Product Manager is responsible for translating these inputs into product priorities, roadmap decisions, and engineering execution. Major roadmap initiatives, client-driven feature requests, and new integrations are expected to be aligned between the Product Manager and the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor before implementation. The Ideal Candidate We are specifically looking for candidates who have operated at a senior level and can demonstrate deep, hands-on exposure to tokenization and traditional financial infrastructure. You should be able to recognise yourself in most of the following: Tokenization, end-to-end
• You have personally built, shipped, or owned a tokenization product — from asset onboarding and smart contract specification through to custody integration, investor cap table management, and secondary transfer mechanics.
• You can walk through the full token lifecycle (issuance, transfer, redemption, corporate actions, burn) without needing to look anything up, and you understand the tradeoffs between different implementation approaches.
• You understand custody models: the difference between self-custody, qualified custodian models, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures, and what each means for compliance and operational risk.
• You have practical knowledge of on-chain settlement mechanics and how they interact with traditional T+1/T+2 settlement rails (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT).
• You are fluent in token standards across multiple chains and understand when to reach for ERC-20, ERC-1400, or proprietary structures, and why. TradFi depth
• You have a strong grasp of how institutional financial infrastructure works: how funds are structured and administered, how broker-dealers clear and settle, how banks manage trust and custody relationships, and how prime brokerage operates.
• You understand the instruments being tokenized: money market funds, bonds, structured credit, equities, real estate, commodities including how each is priced, transferred, and serviced in the traditional world.
• You are comfortable with regulatory frameworks relevant to tokenized assets such as MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA and can identify the compliance constraints that must be encoded into product design.
• You can read and rapidly interpret institutional documents: RFPs, term sheets, custody agreements, and due diligence questionnaires, and translate them into product requirements without extensive hand-holding. Institutional demand, rapid translation
• You have worked directly with institutional clients such as asset managers, banks, sovereign funds, family offices as the primary product owner, and you know how to manage their expectations and extract signals from noise.
• You can hear a new institutional use case or a complex integration requirement and rapidly assess feasibility, scope, and priority, without needing days to research the basics.
• You have experience distinguishing between requests that reveal genuine product gaps and those that are bespoke client customisations and you know how to handle both without derailing the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and maintain the Hadron product roadmap.
• Prioritize product initiatives based on market demand, technical feasibility, and business impact.
• Maintain a clear product vision for Hadron across multiple asset classes and blockchain networks.
• Ensure long-term platform scalability and product coherence. Product Development & Delivery
• Translate business and market needs into clear product requirements.
• Maintain the product backlog and development priorities.
• Coordinate development cycles and feature releases.
• Ensure timely delivery of roadmap milestones. Engineering Coordination
• Act as the primary interface between product and engineering.
• Coordinate development work with internal engineers and external technology partners.
• Maintain clear documentation of product features, APIs, and platform capabilities.
• Track platform performance, bugs, and technical improvements. Client & Integration Feedback
• Collect and structure feedback from institutional clients and internal teams.
• Identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into product improvements.
• Improve onboarding workflows and developer experience.
• 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with at least 3 years in digital assets, tokenization, or financial infrastructure.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with accountability for the full token lifecycle.
• Deep, working knowledge of TradFi capital markets infrastructure including settlement, custody, clearing, fund structures.
• Proven ability to rapidly parse institutional requirements and translate them into actionable product decisions.
• Experience managing external engineering partners and enforcing scope discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder programmes.
• Regulatory literacy across at least two major tokenization frameworks (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, or equivalent).
• Excellent written and spoken English. Able to author crisp product specs, client-facing documentation, and executive summaries. Nice to have:
• Prior experience at a bank, asset manager, custodian, or regulated fintech in a product, technology, or markets role.
• Hands-on experience with multiple token standards and blockchain networks in a production context.
• Experience designing or integrating with custody APIs, transfer agent systems, or fund administration platforms.
• Understanding of on-chain compliance mechanisms: whitelisting, transfer restrictions, KYC/AML hooks at the smart contract level.
• Exposure to multi-chain deployment strategies and the tradeoffs between L1, L2, and permissioned chain environments.
• Experience with institutional client onboarding workflows in a regulated context. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
